_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]、{p} 近くの伝説の神殿の入口で Kelight と話す

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.dst: この荘厳な神殿に入りたいようだな！否定しても無駄だ、目に書いてある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.dst: 当然だろう、何しろ私のような伝説の栄えある一員になりたいのだからな！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.dst: 力を示すには、私の傍らの洞窟の奥に潜む強大な獣と戦わねばならん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.dst: ふむ…一見、何の取り柄もなさそうだ！どう見てもただの一兵卒ではないか！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.dst: 言ってみたまえ、なぜ君に機会を与えねばならん？今のところ、感心できんな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.dst: 頑固だと？はっ！笑わせるな。見せるものもなく入ろうとしたのが君が初めてだとでも？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.dst: 当然違う。さあ、行きたまえ。本当に感心させるものを持って出直すことだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.dst: …で？まさか買収する気ではあるまいな？君のわずかな財産など、私に何の役に立つ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.dst: 私は伝説だぞ！一生分必要なものは全て揃っている！さあ行きたまえ。確かなものを見せられるようになったら戻ってこい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.dst: はっ！君が？伝説だと？！笑わせる。ちなみにそう言ったのは君が初めてではない。仲間は一人残らず知っているが、君はその中にいない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.dst: ああ、神殿の門番とは実に愉快な役目だ。さあ行きたまえ。本物を見せられるようになったら戻ってこい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.dst: ふん。馬鹿馬鹿しい。君に説得される必要などない！明らかに、君はただの偽物だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.dst: さあ、行きたまえ。見せるものがないなら、私の時間を無駄にするな！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#016.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#016.dst: …だが…ああ。まだいるのか。ひょっとして…いや、馬鹿を言うな、Kelight。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#016.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.dst: しっかりしろ、Kelight、黙っていられるだけで折れるわけにはいかんぞ…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#018.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#018.dst: ええい、分かった。興味が湧いた。君の何が特別なんだ？ただの一兵卒に見えるが、それでも…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#018.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.dst: よろしい。試練への挑戦を許そう。そうすれば、力を証明できるかもしれん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#020.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#020.dst: 近くの洞窟の奥深くに、比類なき獣が潜んでいる。腐敗してはいるが、これまでの敵とはまるで違う。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#020.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.dst: 名は Jorkin、あの領域について私の知る誰よりも詳しい。{p} の {p} 近くで彼を探し、助力を頼め。私の紹介だと言うといい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.dst: Kelight に [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の伝説の神殿へ入れてもらう方法を探す。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.dst: 戻ってきたか！実に興味深い。確かにこれまでの挑戦者より一段上だ…だが、まだ足りん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.dst: で？言ってみたまえ、なぜ君に機会を与えねばならん？今のところ、感心できんな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.dst: そうか！私もだ。残念だが、そう簡単に私は通さんぞ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.dst: では行きたまえ。見せるものがないなら戻ってくるな！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.dst: ああ、そんな気がしてきたよ。君は本当に頭痛の種だな、分かっているか？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.dst: 分かった！分かったよ。機会をやろう。成功するとは思えんが、君が付きまとうのをやめるなら何でもいい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.dst: コホン。近くの洞窟の奥深くに、比類なき獣が潜んでいる。腐敗してはいるが、これまでの敵とはまるで違う。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Jorkin に Light Dust について聞く。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.dst: やあ、兵士さん。今日はこのあばら家に何のご用で？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.dst: なんと。き、君は…「あいつ」を攻めたいと？あ、あの恐ろしい獣を！正気か？！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.dst: ああもう、Kelight はあの馬鹿げた課題で君みたいな冒険者を死に送り続けている！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.dst: わかった。そこまで死にに行きたいなら、行き先を教えよう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.dst: the Roots を下った先に、必要な Light Dust だらけの洞窟がある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.dst: あの洞窟には強い腐敗者が棲んでいる。取る時はくれぐれも用心して、見つけたら持ってきてくれ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#037.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#037.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] のポータル近くにある光の塵の洞窟を見つける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.dst: [{~} Light Dust] を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟から取り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Jorkin に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.dst: Light Dust を手に入れたか？こっちへ。確かめたいことがある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#040.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#040.dst: ああ、思った通りだ。この光さえ腐敗に汚されている。残念だが戦うのは無理だ、帰りなさい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#040.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#041.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#041.dst: …うう、君はごまかせないな？本気であいつと戦う気なんだな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#041.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#042.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#042.dst: まあ、Light Dust が腐敗しているのは嘘じゃない。だが浄化する方法はある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#042.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#043.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#043.dst: 古い知人の Rayshyroth が方法を知っている。{p} に住んでいる。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#043.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#044.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#044.dst: あの…ものについては、私が長年ネザーを研究してきた以上に詳しい。君を思いとどまらせてくれるかもな。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#044.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#045.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#045.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} にいる Rayshyroth を訪ね、塵を浄化してもらう

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#046.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#046.dst: おや？これはどうも。静かで寂しいこの島に、しかもこんな上まで何のご用です？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#046.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#047.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#047.dst: もちろんできますが、材料が要ります。今のあなたなら難しくないはずですよ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#047.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#048.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#048.dst: 実はこの家の下に泉がありましてね、そこから強い魔力の流れが湧いているのです。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#048.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.dst: それを乱すと独特の魔法の蒸気が生じます。それで塵を浄化してあげましょう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.dst: これほど腐敗がひどいと、少なくとも [{~} Sky Vapor] は必要ですね。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#051.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#051.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある、{p} の Sky Flux が集まる洞窟を見つける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#052.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#052.dst: [{~} Sky Vapor] を [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Rayshyroth に渡す。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.dst: おお、Sky Vapor を持って戻りましたね！登るのは大変だったでしょう、私も時々不便に感じます。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#054.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#054.dst: 浄化の儀式をする間に、一つ聞きたい。あなたは自分が何と戦うのか、正確に分かっていますか？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#054.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.dst: そう驚かないで。Light Dust の用途は分かっています。腐敗除けの兜…Corrupter of Worlds と戦うためでしょう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#056.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#056.dst: …もっとも、話はさまざまです。最初にポータルに入ったのは Bak'al で、Corrupter of Worlds はネザーの獣にすぎないという説も。ですが真相が曖昧でも、奴の強さは変わりません。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#056.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.dst: 覚えておいて。あの高慢な Kelight 以外、戦わないと決めてもあなたを見下す者はいません。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.src: Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.dst: [Purified Light Dust] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の伝説の神殿入口にいる Kelight に見せる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.dst: 魔力を身の回りに集める品が要る、身に着ける物がいい。ふむ…兜はどうだ？君のひどいセンスにも大いに役立つだろう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.dst: コホン。作り手だが…君の安全を保証できる防具を作れる男は、一人しか知らん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.dst: あいにく、会うのは難しい。名は Garull、私が会った中で最高の職人だった！少々変わり者だがね。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.dst: いつもクリーパーのことをわめき散らしていてな…本当にいると思っていたんだ、信じられるか？まったくの戯言だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.dst: ともかく、探し始める場所にはなる！見つけて兜を作るよう説得できたら、ここに戻れ。そこから先へ進もう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 付近の {p} で、クリーパーに執着する職人 Garull を見つける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.dst: うわあっ！びっくりさせるなよ！だ…誰なんだあんた？！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.dst: ああ、Kelight に言われて防護の兜を？作れるとも、ただいくつか厄介なことがある。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.dst: 俺は防具にふつう Touroto Hide ってのを使う。すごく丈夫で、魔法に強く、なかなか破れない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.dst: でもそのせいで Touroto 自体がほぼ殺せない。Touroto Hide を手に入れるのは至難の業だ。{p} に闇市があるのは知ってるが…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.dst: 売ってるのは老衰で死んだ個体から取った、役立たずの Old Touroto Hide だけ。ただの革とほとんど変わらない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [Old Touroto Hide], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.dst: だから兜を作るには、[Old Touroto Hide] だけじゃなく、元の力を取り戻す材料も持ってきてほしい。よく聞けよ、話すことは山ほどある！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.dst: まず [Aseado Leaf]、{p} のどこかに生えてる…強い薬効があって、老化を逆戻りさせるらしい。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.dst: 次に [Maro's Eye Jewel]、すごい魔法の焦点具で…出どころはもちろん {p} だ。その粉で、魔法の耐性を手作業で戻せる。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Finally, I'll need a [Coral of Nelfors], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.dst: 最後に [Coral of Nelfors]、{p} で見つかる。これで皮に魔法耐性の付呪をするんだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.dst: 全部コンテンツブックに書いといた。揃ったら会いに来てくれ、でも頼むからこっそり近づくのはやめてくれよ！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.dst: [Old Touroto Hide]、[Aseado Leaf]、[Maro's Eye Jewel]、[Coral of Nelfors] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟にいる Garull に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#076.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#076.dst: 今度はそっと来ないでくれてありがとな。全部揃ったんだろ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#076.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.dst: よし、すぐ済む。Kelight はいくら偉そうでも、俺に作らせに来させたのは正解だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.dst: さて、一つ警告しておきたい。その兜で立ち向かう敵の噂を聞いたが、どれもろくな話じゃない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.dst: あいつの言う「獣」を倒して戻った奴も見たことはあるが、めったにいない。戦うなら十分気をつけろ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.dst: [Helmet of the Legends] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の伝説の神殿入口にいる Kelight に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.dst: 兜は持っているのだろう？こちらへ。すぐに光の塵を施そう。そうすれば洞窟に入れる。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.dst: …では、健闘を祈る！成功するか、盛大に失敗するか、どちらかだろう。まあ、どちらでも。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.dst: 獣に勝った確かな証拠を持ってこい、そうすれば伝説の神殿への通行を許そう！急いでくれたまえよ？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟で Corrupter of Worlds を倒し、その死の証を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Kelight に届ける。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.dst: …き、君が…倒した？ど、どうやって？！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.dst: 私のように勇敢で強大な者でさえ、あれを相手に生き延びるなど―
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.dst: あ…いや、もちろん君なら獣を倒せると思っていた！最初から信じていたとも！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.dst: …コホン。これで伝説の神殿に歓迎しよう！君は…確かに力を示した。見くびってすまなかった。その功績を誇りたまえ！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.dst: む？その妙な物は何だ？珍しいが役に立たんな。私が処分してやろう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: Comprehensive Guide to Raising an Animal
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.dst: 動物の育て方 完全手引き

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: This guide shall serve as your one-stop shop to caring for mounts.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.dst: この手引きは、マウントの世話に関することをひととおりまとめたものだ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.src: To ensure that a mount has the room and ability to grow and become strong, certain conditions have to be met.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.dst: マウントが育ち、強くなるための余地と力を得るには、いくつかの条件を満たす必要がある。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.src: To start, a mount has to be placed inside a Feeder to be used. Feeders can be found in Enclosures.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.dst: まず、マウントは給餌器に入れないと使えない。給餌器は囲いの中にある。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: For starters, a mount will get tired as you train it. They are living beings after all! Ensure they have enough food in their Feeder so they can regain their energy.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.dst: はじめに、マウントは訓練すると疲れてくる。何しろ生き物なのだ！元気を取り戻せるよう、給餌器に十分な食べ物を入れておくこと。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: Mounts love to eat or chew on almost any crafting material harvested from crop fields, from fish, even from trees and stones! Just make sure the material's level matches that of the mount for greatest effectiveness.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.dst: マウントは、畑で採れたもの、魚から取れたもの、果ては木や石まで、ほとんどどんな生産素材でも食べたりかじったりするのが大好きだ！ただし、素材のレベルをマウントのレベルに合わせると効果が最も高くなる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: You can purchase tools from Tool Merchants all over the provinces to harvest these materials yourself, too! Bring Grains, String, Paper, Planks, Ingots, Gems, Meat, or Oil to the Feeder to have a happy, well-fed mount.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.dst: 各地方の道具商人から道具を買って、自分で素材を採ることもできる！穀物、糸、紙、板材、インゴット、宝石、肉、油のいずれかを給餌器に入れれば、マウントは腹も心も満たされる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Certain materials will boost different stats. For example, meat will boost Energy and Acceleration. They need a varied diet, just like us.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.dst: 素材によって上がる能力が変わる。たとえば肉はエネルギーと加速を上げる。我々と同じで、食事には偏りがないほうがよいのだ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: Breeding is useful for creating a strong and fast mount, capable of the most grueling journeys.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.dst: 交配は、どんな過酷な旅にも耐えられる、強くて速いマウントを作るのに役立つ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.src: To breed a mount, simply put two of the same mount in the same row of a Feeder. Give it some time and you will see an offspring. A mount is only capable of breeding once they reach an average Limit of {~}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.dst: マウントを交配させるには、同じ種類のマウント二頭を給餌器の同じ列に入れるだけでよい。しばらく待てば子が生まれる。マウントは平均の限界値が {~} に達して初めて交配できるようになる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.src: The offspring will inherit some of the parents' visual traits, and will have a chance to gain better stats. If the mounts bred had any previous training done, the offspring will inherit that as well.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.dst: 子は親の見た目の特徴をいくつか受け継ぎ、より高い能力を得る可能性もある。交配させたマウントが以前に訓練を受けていれば、子はそれも受け継ぐ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: A mount's level can be increased to the Limit by training it. However, it can be further increased to its Max by feeding it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.dst: マウントのレベルは訓練によって「限界値」まで上げられる。さらに餌を与えれば「最大値」まで伸ばすことができる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: Ensure your mounts have good food to eat if you want them to become strong! Refer to the General Information chapter for more information on feeding.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.dst: マウントを強くしたいなら、よい餌を食べさせること！餌についての詳細は「基本情報」の章を参照してほしい。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Although most traits are self-explanatory, this guide has them sorted in a list for your convenience.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.dst: 特性の多くは名前を見れば分かるが、便宜のため、この手引きでは一覧にまとめてある。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: Speed is all about the max speed your mount can reach.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.dst: 「速度」は、マウントが出せる最高速度のことだ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.src: Acceleration will ensure your mount reaches its max speed faster.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.dst: 「加速」は、マウントが最高速度に達するまでを早くする。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: Jump Height is all about... you guessed it - how high your mount can jump!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.dst: 「ジャンプの高さ」は……察しのとおり――マウントがどれだけ高く跳べるかだ！

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: Increasing the Energy stat increases the max energy your mount will have. A worthwhile investment if you're planning to travel across the provinces.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.dst: 「エネルギー」を上げると、マウントのエネルギー上限が増える。地方をまたいで旅をするつもりなら、投じる価値のある能力だ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: Handling is all about your mount's movement efficiency.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.dst: 「操縦性」は、マウントの移動の効率のことだ。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: Increasing the stat will allow your mount to more easily climb steep surfaces, turn faster, and be slightly more nimble before they reach their top speeds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.dst: この能力を上げると、マウントは急な斜面を登りやすくなり、方向転換も速くなり、最高速度に達する前の動きも少し軽快になる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Toughness helps prevent your mount from becoming startled and throwing you off, in case you're ambushed by an enemy.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.dst: 「頑丈さ」は、敵に不意を突かれたときに、マウントが驚いて乗り手を投げ落とさないようにしてくれる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: Boost will ensure that your mounts make the most out of the boosts they find in the wild.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.dst: 「ブースト」は、野外で見つけた加速装置をマウントが最大限に活かせるようにする。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: A good Training trait will allow your mount to more easily become stronger and improve as you train it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.dst: 「訓練」の特性がよいと、マウントは強くなりやすく、訓練による成長も伸びやすい。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things. Such a premise is hard to believe.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.dst: 噂では、この生き物はあのポータルに最初に足を踏み入れた鉱夫の一人だったという……もちろん、伝説たる私なら、普段ならそんな話は取り合わない。前提として信じがたいものだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.speaker: Kelight

similar.text: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: In any case, its power cannot be understated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.dst: いずれにせよ、その力は侮れん。洞窟に入るだけで、最高の装備でも大きく弱体化してしまう！
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light whose origin is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.dst: 近づけばすぐに腐敗してしまう、だから守りが要る。獣がやって来たのと同じ領域の光でなければ効かんのだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Portal and that which lies... beyond.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.dst: そこで、伝説になるための旅の第一歩は……あのポータルと、その……向こうにあるものを研究している私の友人を訪ねることだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.speaker: Kelight

similar.text: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've retrieved the light you'll need for protection.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.dst: どうした？任務は与えたはずだろう？身を守るために必要な光を手に入れるまで戻ってくるな。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.dst: …なるほど。ええ、忌々しいネザーポータルの腐敗はかなり強力です。浄化が必要なのも当然でしょう。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was its title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how it came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.dst: ええ、ええ。Kelight はそれが奴の称号だと教えなかったのでしょう。奴の成り立ちもろくに聞いていないはずだ…
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds is said to have been a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. It is told he was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.dst: 今では Corrupter of Worlds と呼ばれるあの獣は、Nether ポータルを発見した探索の折には、ただの採掘隊長にすぎなかったという。あの邪悪な領域に最初に入ったのは彼だったと伝えられている。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: The man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Realm of War, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.dst: その男の消息は二度と聞かれなかった……いや、腐敗の群れが「戦の領域」からあふれ出し、その先頭に彼が立つまではな。少し皮肉ではないか？生前は鉱夫を率い、死してからは腐敗者を率いたのだ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Rayshyroth

similar.text: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: The mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.dst: 彼の採掘隊は数分ともたなかった。元の隊員を一人残らず自ら惨殺し、さらに何千もの命を奪った。ネザーの力が彼を途方もなく強くしたのです。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: Hah. Took you long enough! This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.dst: はっ。ずいぶんかかったな。これが光の塵かね？
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: I'll hold on to this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.dst: これはひとまず預かろう。君の守りに欠かせない材料だが、これだけでは足りん。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I don't know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.dst: 馬鹿げていると言ったら機嫌を損ねたようで、来なくなった。私の何が悪かったのか、本当に分からん。困った男だ。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank have ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.dst: 今となっては、どこにいるか見当もつかん。Pigman Ravines を研究したいと何度か言っていたが、仲間の誰もそこで彼を見ていない。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.src: Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've found Garull and obtained a helmet.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.dst: どうした？任務は与えたはずだろう？Garull を見つけて兜を手に入れるまで戻ってくるな。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you manage to actually find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.dst: …む？ああ、また君か。本当にあの変人を見つけたのか？少なくとも生きていると分かってよかった。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight it. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.dst: 奴に挑んだ前の一団よりはうまくやってほしいものだ。六人の戦士が…誰も戻らなかった。
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: ...You're still here? You have your challenge. Slay that beast within the cave, and bring me proof. Then, and only then, will you have proven your worth.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.dst: ……まだここにいるのか？挑戦はもう与えてある。あの洞窟の獣を討ち、証を持ってこい。そのときに、そのときにだけ、お前は自らの価値を示したことになる。

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.src: I am proud to have you in our temple! Perhaps one day you shall be almost as great as I am!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.dst: お前を我らの神殿に迎えられて誇らしい！いつかは私とほぼ同じくらい偉大になるかもしれんな！

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Legend Guard 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

similar.text: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! To prove you are even worth my time, return when you reach Level {~}.
